//: AUTH-04D1: what the future ingress of the Authority pilot origin must do. A specification, not a deployment: no DNS record, certificate, proxy, VM or cloud resource exists, and nothing here configures one. Checked against the gateway and the web client by tests/authority-pilot-ingress-contract.test.mjs. Topology and rationale: docs/security/AUTH-04D1-AUTHORITY-PILOT-RECOVERY-READINESS.md section 7.

tls.certificate: publicly trusted, covering authority.frontera-systems.com only (no wildcard shared with any other site)
tls.plainHttp: port 80 answers only with a redirect to https://authority.frontera-systems.com, and carries no cookie

routes.cache: never: no shared or private cache stores a response
routes.notes: Host and Origin reach the gateway exactly as the browser sent them: the gateway refuses another Host (421) or Origin (403). An Authorization header is never added; if a client sends one it is forwarded so the gateway refuses it.
Only the files of the reproducible build (asset-manifest.json lists them with their sha256). No directory listing, no fallback to any other upstream.

authority-gateway.exposure: loopback or a private network only; reachable from the internet solely through this ingress

static.exposure: files on the ingress machine; no application server

neverRoutedFromThisOrigin.what: the Host's main listener (/api/governed-actions, /api/admin/... including the CTRL-02/04 operator plane and passkey invitations, /api/governance/..., /health, /ready)
neverRoutedFromThisOrigin.why: operator bearer credentials and administration stay on a private network; the browser origin has no path to them
a different machine and restore domain; only the Host talks to it

neverRoutedFromThisOrigin.what: the authority signer, the backup storage and the secret manager
neverRoutedFromThisOrigin.why: custody and recovery material never sit behind a public origin

cors: none: no Access-Control-* response header on any route, and no preflight handling; the client is same-origin by construction

rateLimits.clientIdentity: the TCP peer address as the ingress sees it; a client-supplied X-Forwarded-For or Forwarded header is never trusted

rules.onExceed: 429 before the request reaches the gateway
429 before the request reaches the gateway
429 before the request reaches the gateway

forbidden: an operator bearer, API key, witness token, signing key or backup key in any ingress configuration, header, environment or served file
adding, removing or rewriting Host, Origin, Cookie or x-frontera-csrf-token
serving the marketing site or any other application from this origin
routing any path to the Host's main listener, the witness or the signer
